paragraphs: Our daily source showed Iraq's official rate for a dollar rise 8.9243% between 6 Oct and 9 Oct 2026. The street price was already up 6.4253% on 7 Oct, before the official rate crossed 3.0% on 9 Oct.
Iraq's cabinet approved a new official rate for the dinar in a decision dated 6 Oct [1]. It acted on an urgent request from the finance minister and the governor of the Central Bank of Iraq [1].

sources.title: Iraq cabinet approves dinar devaluation to 1,520 per dollar
